title: Repeated NPC warnings implying a day/night danger cycle ('mind the cairns after dark,' 'give the Weeping Cairn a wide berth after') never once manifested as an observable mechanic — no time-of-day state or consequence was ever visible.
where: Highward Parade Ground/Sergeant Rook dialogue; The Mound-Warden's House/talk to warden
